svg.text: BYOBC: Build Your Own Binary Cache

g.text: • Input identity: Same derivation → Same expected /nix/store path
• Isolation: Sandboxing reduces undeclared host dependencies
• Reproducibility: Bit identity must be verified across independent builds
Creating Your Cache: Local or Remote
Use key when writing a signed cache
Common Uses: LAN-speed sharing • Air-gapped networks • CI pipelines • Custom overlays • Cost control
Result: Your cache speaks the same protocol as cache.nixos.org (locally or remotely!)
